_comment: Stormwood NPC dialogue draft. Three state conversations per contract NPC; requires_flags are intended bindings for the runtime owner. This lane does not add flags, objectives or plot beats.

stormwood_rodkeeper_hesk_arrival.speaker: Rodkeeper Hesk
lines: You came down from Cloudreach? Then you remember what a storm sounds like when it ends. Ours no longer does.
The outer trees are dying. Our arches have gone dark, and the rod lines carry every strike toward Team Tether's works in the split tree.
Stay under Ashfoot's shelter when the light begins to build. Tamsin will show you how to read a Break. We need stormglass to light the road to the Lantern Pools again.

stormwood_rodkeeper_hesk_in_progress.speaker: Rodkeeper Hesk
lines: This Long Storm is killing the outer canopy. Team Tether says its rod lines keep us safe, but they carry the lightning away from our homes and into that split tree.
Our stormglass arches used to join these roads. With their cores dark, families at the Lantern Pools might as well be in another realm.
Watch a Break with Tamsin from Ashfoot's shelter. After the warning flashes, charged stormglass becomes harvestable. Bring it to the camp's dark arch and we can begin opening the road.

stormwood_rodkeeper_hesk_post_storm.speaker: Rodkeeper Hesk
lines: Rodkeeper Hesk: The roads are answering again, and the quiet places are safe to visit.
Follow the marked road beneath the first struck trunks. The route is open enough to take your time.
Ask after the nearest rod line and the next safe clearing. We will keep this place ready for the next traveler.

Follow the marked road beneath the first struck trunks. The rod station sits beyond the waycamp; exposed glass is a poor place to linger.
A short detour can teach you more than rushing the ridge.

Ondra remembers how to build a twin for the Crown arch. Without that road, we cannot reach the heartstone that holds the Rootgate shut.

stormwood_keeper_ondra_in_progress.speaker: Keeper Ondra
lines: With Varga driven off, we can carry the tools again. I will teach you the Stormglass Arch recipe.
An arch needs its twin. Build this one on the Still Grove footing, using Crown-grade stormglass gathered during a Break. The old Crown arch is waiting across the Glass Sink.
The footing fixes the alignment. You cannot plant this arch elsewhere and expect the road to answer.

stormwood_archivist_wen_arrival.speaker: Archivist Wen
lines: Archivist Wen: The marks here are records of pressure, not decoration.
The Crown is reached by its arch, and the black sink below is not a road. Stay on the pale island footing; the dark glass outside it takes strikes.
Walk the island edge and compare what the glass remembers.

stormwood_archivist_wen_in_progress.speaker: Archivist Wen
lines: These records remember storms moving into the forest. The newest marks run the other way: out of the split tree.
The Dynamo is making the Long Storm. Its rod lines do not contain the Rift; they feed it. Team Tether has reversed the old network.
The Crown heartstone still commands the Rootgate. Restore its connection, then follow the opened road to Lantern Hollow. Someone there must know what powers the machine.

stormwood_defector_sable_in_progress.speaker: Sable
lines: I worked the crown lifts. There is a living creature inside the Stormheart Tree, held above the core. Marrow is drawing the storm through it.
We called the machine the Dynamo as if that made the screaming something ordinary. It is a prison, and every rod station keeps it working.
Cut the remaining rod lines. Rest at Ember Bivouac before the ascent. Inside the core, break the capacitor banks and use the rod plates to turn the discharge away from your team.
